Tom Martinez

Best regards,
Tom Martinez

initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I need a quote ASAP for the following items:
- 2x WonderWagon Bicycle
- 5x T-Shirt (Item No: AITEM-0023)
- 1x Rasta Espresso Machine

Please do NOT ship to my usual billing address. I want these delivered to our warehouse in Springfield. You should have this location on file, but just in case, it's the one near the old industrial park. I don't have the full street address handy right now, but it's the Springfield warehouse we've used before. If you need more info, check your records or let me know, but I expect you to figure this out quickly.

I need this quote today. Don't waste time with unnecessary steps.

Sarah Johnson

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson
